scientific_role: Replicate the seed-0 early-benefit to late-inversion boundary before any trust diagnostic or intervention is authorized.
scope_guard: E5a tests the self-fed rollout boundary. It does not re-estimate the separately measured single-step addressability effect and it cannot establish a universal trust law.

long_reach_hierarchy.context: 56 coarse slots at stride 4 plus 6 recent fine slots

interfaces.matching_statement: The cells match head, backbone family, parameter scale, training examples, optimizer, EMA, sampler and evaluation geometry. Context reach, spatial fidelity, context-token count and the legacy coupled coarse target interface intentionally differ; this is a configuration-level trust comparison, not a pure stride or equal-token intervention.

single_step_addressability.role: external prerequisite, not an E5a endpoint
single_step_addressability.statement: GT-fed stride56x4 addressability replicated at seeds 0 and 1 and was localized to the reach-differential band; effect magnitude was seed-variable.

evaluation.primary_metric: legacy-compatible GT-foreground MSE on non-empty GT-foreground records
evaluation.effect_convention: comparator error minus long-reach-hierarchy error; positive favors hierarchy
mechanistic_secondary: early and late effects restricted to HARD records
answerable HARD records with dt greater than the 48-frame comparator reach
horizon-by-hardness table matching the seed-0 report
evaluation.interval: paired clip-cluster bootstrap, 10000 replicates, seed 0, two-sided percentile 95% interval
evaluation.multiplicity: The replication claim is an intersection-union requirement: both preregistered directional windows must pass. Secondary rows cannot rescue a failed primary gate.

decision_rule.per_seed_ci_clean_boundary: early_benefit lower 95% bound > 0 AND late_inversion upper 95% bound < 0
decision_rule.per_seed_directional_boundary: early_benefit point estimate > 0 AND late_inversion point estimate < 0
decision_rule.REPLICATED: both new seeds satisfy the CI-clean boundary
decision_rule.DIRECTIONALLY_REPLICATED: both new seeds satisfy the directional boundary but at least one is not CI-clean
decision_rule.HETEROGENEOUS_PARTIAL: exactly one new seed satisfies the directional boundary
decision_rule.NOT_REPLICATED: neither new seed satisfies the directional boundary
decision_rule.e5b_gate: REPLICATED permits the full frozen E5b diagnostic design; DIRECTIONALLY_REPLICATED permits only a reduced diagnostic design after a new freeze; HETEROGENEOUS_PARTIAL or NOT_REPLICATED demotes the title-level empirical trust claim and does not authorize the full E5b programme.
decision_rule.terminal_rule: E5a ends after seeds 1 and 2 regardless of outcome. No extra training seed is authorized by E5a.

budget.accounting: wall-clock project GPU ownership including training, evaluation, failed attempts, resumes and uploads

compatibility.regime: legacy H-grid3 B8x40k kernel wrapped by provenance-v2
compatibility.reason: Changing batch size or learning rate to occupy more VRAM would change the optimizer regime and invalidate replication. The measured seed-0 cells used 3.64 and 7.39 GiB allocated VRAM.
